result.summary: The pedestrian environment at this signalized intersection is poor, lacking marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. A large vehicle parked at the corner creates a significant visual obstruction, further compromising safety in this commercial area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A black SUV with an open trunk is parked directly at the corner, blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left, at the intersection corner

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads despite being controlled by traffic lights.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide multi-lane roadway and a large commercial parking lot, creating a vehicle-centric atmosphere. While a sidewalk and basic transverse crosswalk are present, the lack of pedestrian signals and high-visibility markings reduces safety for those crossing.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection to provide safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light pole on the left side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles in the adjacent lot may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to enter the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Parking spaces immediately to the left of the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information for people crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked high-visibility crosswalk and curb ramps adjacent to a commercial building. However, the environment is car-centric with wide lanes, a lack of visible pedestrian signals, and a vehicle obstructing sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A black SUV is stopped immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground, next to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and standing near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane arterial road serving commercial land uses, with no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks exist along the perimeter of the parking lots, the lack of safe crossing infrastructure creates a significant barrier and high risk for people walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing path for pedestrians across the wide intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway and the commercial driveway entrance.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane road width exposes pedestrians to traffic for a long duration without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the roadway visible in the foreground.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signal heads, leaving walkers to guess when it is safe to cross based on vehicular lights.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.
